review.sameAiCmd: claude -p --model sonnet "$(cat {task})" --tools Read,Grep,Glob --strict-mcp-config --permission-mode dontAsk --no-session-persistence --settings '{"disableAllHooks":true}' --append-system-prompt '파일 도구는 읽기 전용이다. result.json을 쓰지 말고, 그 배열을 findings에 담아 답한다.' --output-format json --json-schema '{"type":"object","required":["findings"],"properties":{"findings":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["file","line","rank","severity","verdict","checklist","reason","nextAction"],"properties":{"file":{"type":"string"},"line":{"type":"integer"},"rank":{"type":"integer"},"severity":{"enum":["높음","중간","낮음"]},"verdict":{"enum":["confirmed","doubtful"]},"checklist":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"},"nextAction":{"type":"string"}}}}}}' | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',(d)=>{s+=d}).on('end',()=>process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(s).structured_output.findings)))" > {out}/result.json
